description.html:
Our Premium Metal Drink Bottles are designed for busy school days and weekend adventures. With 500ml capacity, double-wall insulation and a leakproof design, they keep water cold and mess-free all day. The colour-matched flip straw lid and silicone bumper protect against drops and scrapes while giving kids a fun way to show off their favourite colour combo.

Each bottle is personalised with your child’s name and a vibrant wrap-around design that will never peel or fade. Teachers love them because bottles are easy to return to kids, and parents love them because they last longer and don’t end up in the lost property box.

Perfect for school, sports or everyday use, these custom drink bottles make a practical and fun choice for both kids and teens.

Want to refresh their drink bottle look or swap colours to match a new school bag? Our separate Lid & Bumper Colour Sets make it easy. Grab a set from our Bottle Lid & Bumper Set and customise your child’s bottle in minutes.

Care Tips: Hand wash recommended to keep colours vibrant. Not suitable for dishwasher or steriliser.

Specifications:

  • Dimensions: 205mm tall × 78mm diameter
  • Bottle weight: 332g
  • Lid only: 77g
  • Bumper only: 16g
  • Lid and bumper combined: 93g

Personalisation Note: Your child’s name will be printed exactly as entered. Please check spelling carefully before ordering.

*Disclaimer: Insulation tested under indoor conditions. Bottles kept water cold for 24 hours during testing.

short_description_right.html:

  • 500ml Capacity, Lightweight at 332g
  • Colour-Matched Lid & Protective Silicone Bumper
  • Wrap-Around Full Colour Print
  • Shipped Fast from Australia

short_description.html:
Keep your kids hydrated in style with our Premium Metal Drink Bottles. These insulated drink bottles are parent-approved for school and sports, with double-wall stainless steel to keep drinks cool for up to 24 hours* and leakproof lids to stop spills in backpacks.

Each bottle comes with a colour-matched lid and protective silicone bumper, giving it extra durability while making it fun for kids and teens to personalise. Add their name and pick from loads of vibrant designs so their drink bottle always comes home from school. Printed in Australia and shipped fast.
